name: Kogoeto Honori
source:
She's Nariyuki's cousin, though neither of them remembers each other at all.

She came to the city from the countryside to study for university entrance exams. A meddlesome, skilled cook.

While wary of him taking her virginity, she tries to deepen their friendship as much as possible.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=698944]getchu[/url]]
